description: Ivory-white marble mausoleum commissioned by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal. The complex includes the mausoleum, mosque, guest house, gateway and formal Mughal garden; it is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally more comfortable; early morning helps avoid heat and crowds. Closed to ordinary visitors on Fridays; verify current notices.
how_to_reach: Agra is connected by rail to major Indian cities. Agra Cantt is a major station; Agra Airport and Delhi airport are alternatives. Use local auto, taxi or city transport to reach the east/south gates.
major_attractions: Main mausoleum; mosque; guest house; charbagh garden; Agra Fort; Itimad-ud-Daulah; Mehtab Bagh.
entry_fee_text: District/official tourism information has listed Indian entry at ₹50 plus ₹200 for entry to the main mausoleum; rates can change. Confirm current ASI/official ticketing before travel.
opening_hours_text: Official tourism information: 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes before sunset; closed Fridays. Full-moon night viewing is separately ticketed and subject to rules.

description: A 13th-century red sandstone and marble minaret within a wider archaeological complex. The Qutb Minar ensemble is a UNESCO World Heritage Site managed by the Archaeological Survey of India.
best_time_to_visit: October to March; mornings and late afternoons are usually more comfortable than hot summer midday hours.
how_to_reach: Use the Delhi Metro Yellow Line to Qutub Minar station and continue by auto, taxi or bus. Delhi is served by major rail stations and Indira Gandhi International Airport.
major_attractions: Qutb Minar; Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque; Alai Darwaza; Iron Pillar; Iltutmish tomb; Alai Minar ruins.
entry_fee_text: Ticketed ASI monument. The uploaded draft listed ₹35 online/₹40 counter from secondary websites, but these rates were not confirmed from the current official ticketing page; verify before travel.
opening_hours_text: Use current ASI/official ticketing guidance for exact hours and closure notices; do not rely on conflicting third-party listings.

description: A hilltop palace-fort complex built by the Kachwaha rulers, known for Rajput architecture, courtyards, gateways, mirror work and views over Maota Lake.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally most comfortable; summer afternoons can be very hot.
how_to_reach: About 11 km from central Jaipur. Jaipur has rail and air connections; from the city use local bus, taxi or auto to Amer.
major_attractions: Jaleb Chowk; Diwan-e-Aam; Ganesh Pol; Sheesh Mahal; palace courtyards; Maota Lake views; nearby Jaigarh Fort.
entry_fee_text: Ticketed palace/fort attraction. The uploaded draft reports conflicting secondary rates (₹50–₹200); current official rate not confirmed here. Verify with Rajasthan tourism/monument ticketing before travel.
opening_hours_text: Check current Rajasthan tourism/monument authority notices for exact hours and separate evening show schedules; hours in secondary sources conflict.

description: A UNESCO-listed rock-cut Buddhist cave complex in the Waghora River gorge, known for ancient monasteries, sculpture and surviving murals.
best_time_to_visit: November to March is generally more comfortable. Check monsoon road conditions and current site notices.
how_to_reach: Reach Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar by rail, road or air, then continue by road to the caves. The site is outside the city; verify current bus/shuttle arrangements before travel.
major_attractions: Cave shrines and monasteries; Buddhist murals and sculptures; Waghora gorge viewpoints; visitor interpretation facilities.
entry_fee_text: Ticketed ASI site; the uploaded draft lists ₹35–₹40 for Indian visitors from secondary sources and notes a separate shuttle charge. Current official price was not independently confirmed; check ASI ticketing.
opening_hours_text: The uploaded draft reports Tuesday–Sunday daytime opening and Monday closure from secondary sources. Confirm current hours and weekly closure with ASI before travel.

description: A UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut complex with Buddhist, Hindu and Jain monuments. The Kailasa temple is a remarkable monolithic rock-cut structure within the site.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally more comfortable for exploring the outdoor complex.
how_to_reach: Reach Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar by rail, road or air, then use a taxi, bus or other road transport to Ellora, roughly 30 km from the city.
major_attractions: Kailasa Temple (Cave 16); Buddhist caves; Hindu cave temples; Jain caves; nearby Grishneshwar Temple.
entry_fee_text: Ticketed ASI site. The uploaded draft reports conflicting secondary prices; current domestic adult fee was not confirmed through official ticketing. Verify before travel.
opening_hours_text: The uploaded draft reports Tuesday closure from secondary sources; confirm current opening hours and weekly closure with ASI.

description: A 13th-century temple dedicated to Surya, designed as a monumental stone chariot and renowned for its carved wheels, horses and Kalinga-style architecture. It is UNESCO-listed.
best_time_to_visit: October to February is generally comfortable. The Konark Festival is usually held in December; confirm dates separately.
how_to_reach: About 35 km from Puri and about 65 km from Bhubaneswar. Puri and Bhubaneswar have rail connections; Bhubaneswar airport is the principal air gateway. Continue by bus or road transport.
major_attractions: Sun Temple and carved stone wheels; Konark Archaeological Museum; Chandrabhaga Beach; nearby Puri and coastal attractions.
entry_fee_text: The monument is ticketed. The uploaded draft lists ₹40 from secondary sources, but current official rates should be verified through ASI ticketing.
opening_hours_text: Exact hours should be checked with the current monument authority/ticketing notice; do not rely on conflicting third-party schedules.

description: The archaeological remains of the Vijayanagara capital on the Tungabhadra River, featuring temples, bazaars, royal enclosures and monumental stone architecture. The group is UNESCO-listed.
best_time_to_visit: October to February is generally cooler; avoid the hottest summer afternoons.
how_to_reach: Hospet (Hosapete) is the main rail/road gateway. Continue by local bus, taxi or auto to Hampi. The nearest larger airports require onward road transport; check current connections.
major_attractions: Virupaksha Temple; Vittala Temple and stone chariot; Hampi Bazaar; Royal Enclosure; Lotus Mahal; Elephant Stables; Matanga Hill.
entry_fee_text: Some protected monuments/complexes are ticketed while active temples may not be. The uploaded draft reports conflicting fees; verify each monument’s current ASI ticket requirement.
opening_hours_text: Different monuments and active temples have different schedules. Check official ASI/Hampi World Heritage Area guidance for the specific monument.

description: A UNESCO-listed group of temples built mainly between the 10th and 11th centuries under the Chandela dynasty, renowned for detailed sculpture and temple architecture.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally comfortable for visiting the temple groups.
how_to_reach: Khajuraho has a railway station and airport; road links connect it to Chhatarpur and other Madhya Pradesh cities. Confirm current flight and train schedules.
major_attractions: Western Group including Kandariya Mahadeva and Lakshmana temples; Eastern Jain temples; Southern Group; museum and light-and-sound show where operating.
entry_fee_text: ASI ticketing applies to the Western Group; other groups may have different access rules. Uploaded draft lists ₹35–₹40 from secondary sources; verify current official price and any show ticket separately.
opening_hours_text: Opening times differ among groups and events; verify current ASI timings and show schedule before visiting.

description: A Buddhist archaeological complex centred on the Great Stupa, first commissioned under Emperor Ashoka and developed over centuries. Its gateways and monuments are UNESCO-listed.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally more comfortable for walking around the hilltop complex.
how_to_reach: Sanchi has a small rail station; Vidisha is a nearby rail gateway. Bhopal is the nearest major city and airport, with onward road transport to Sanchi.
major_attractions: Great Stupa and carved gateways; other stupas and monasteries; Sanchi Archaeological Museum; nearby Vidisha heritage sites.
entry_fee_text: Ticketed archaeological site/museum rules may apply. The uploaded draft reports conflicting secondary prices; confirm the domestic adult rate with ASI before travel.
opening_hours_text: The site is generally visited during daylight hours; exact hours and museum closure days should be confirmed with ASI.

description: The central Sikh shrine, surrounded by the sacred Amrit Sarovar and open to visitors of all faiths. The complex includes the Harmandir Sahib, Akal Takht and community kitchen (langar).
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally more comfortable; the shrine receives visitors year-round and major religious dates can be especially crowded.
how_to_reach: Amritsar Junction is a short local journey from the shrine; Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport is also nearby. Taxis, autos and local transport are available.
major_attractions: Harmandir Sahib; Amrit Sarovar; Akal Takht; langar hall; Central Sikh Museum; nearby Jallianwala Bagh.
entry_fee_text: General entry is free. Optional offerings, donations and some services are separate; follow SGPC visitor instructions.
opening_hours_text: The shrine operates on a daily religious schedule; opening/closing and palki timings can vary by season and religious calendar. Check the current SGPC schedule.

description: A UNESCO World Heritage Buddhist sacred complex associated with the place where Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment. It includes the main temple, Bodhi Tree and related sacred spaces.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally more comfortable; major Buddhist observances may bring large crowds.
how_to_reach: Gaya Junction and Gaya Airport are the closest major transport gateways; Patna is a farther alternative. Continue by taxi, auto or bus to Bodh Gaya.
major_attractions: Mahabodhi Temple; Bodhi Tree; Vajrasana; Great Buddha statue; nearby international Buddhist monasteries.
entry_fee_text: General entry for the temple complex is commonly reported as free; fees may apply to cameras or optional services. Confirm current rules with the Bodhgaya Temple Management Committee.
opening_hours_text: The uploaded draft reports approximately 5:00 AM–9:00 PM; confirm current hours and photography rules with the temple management authority.
local_languages: Magahi; Hindi; English; Pali used in religious contexts

description: The archaeological remains of an ancient Buddhist monastic and scholarly institution, with brick monasteries, stupas and temple remains. The site is on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
best_time_to_visit: October to March; start early during warmer months because much of the site is outdoors.
how_to_reach: Rajgir is a nearby rail gateway; Nalanda has a small station. Patna and Gaya provide wider rail/air connectivity with onward road transport.
major_attractions: Monastery remains; main temple and stupas; Nalanda Archaeological Museum; nearby Rajgir and its historical sites.
entry_fee_text: Archaeological site and museum charges may apply. The uploaded draft reports conflicting secondary fees; current official charges should be checked with ASI.
opening_hours_text: Daytime opening is reported in secondary sources, but exact current hours and museum closure days should be verified with ASI.

description: A cultural and educational landscape established by Rabindranath Tagore and associated with Visva-Bharati, open-air learning, art, literature and the Bengal School of Art. Santiniketan is UNESCO-listed.
best_time_to_visit: November to February is generally comfortable. Seasonal cultural events can be busy; confirm campus visitor access in advance.
how_to_reach: Bolpur Shantiniketan railway station is the main rail gateway from Kolkata and other cities. Local autos/e-rickshaws connect the station with town and visitor sites.
major_attractions: Uttarayan complex; Rabindra Bhavana where access permits; Kala Bhavana; Chhatimtala; local craft centres such as Amar Kutir; nearby Kankalitala.
entry_fee_text: There is no single fee for all of Santiniketan. Campus, museum and institutional access rules can change; confirm current access and charges with Visva-Bharati before travel.
opening_hours_text: Visitor access differs by institution and campus area. Confirm current Visva-Bharati museum/campus schedules; do not rely on older third-party reports.

description: A living sandstone fort founded in 1156 and also known as Sonar Qila or the Golden Fort. Homes, temples, shops and historic havelis remain within its walls.
best_time_to_visit: November to February; desert temperatures can be very high in summer.
how_to_reach: Jaisalmer has rail connections and an airport with limited services; many travellers connect via Jodhpur. The fort is in the city and can be reached by local taxi, auto or on foot from central areas.
major_attractions: Fort lanes and viewpoints; Jain temples; Raj Mahal/palace museum where open; Patwon Ki Haveli; Salim Singh Ki Haveli; Gadisar Lake.
entry_fee_text: Access to the living fort area is not the same as entry to individual museums or heritage interiors; those may charge separate fees. Verify each venue’s current ticket.
opening_hours_text: The fort is a living urban area; individual museums, temples and ticketed interiors have separate hours. Confirm the hours for the specific attraction.

description: A high-altitude Hindu pilgrimage temple dedicated to Shiva in the Garhwal Himalaya and one of the twelve Jyotirlingas. Access is seasonal and normally involves road travel to the trek starting point followed by a substantial trek or approved alternatives.
best_time_to_visit: Only during the officially announced pilgrimage season. Spring/early summer and early autumn are commonly used windows; closures, snow and weather affect access. Check the current annual opening/closing notice.
how_to_reach: Reach Haridwar/Rishikesh or another designated gateway, travel by road to Sonprayag and Gaurikund, then follow the official trek route. Mandatory Char Dham registration is free; helicopter options, if operating, must be booked through authorized channels.
major_attractions: Kedarnath Temple; surrounding Himalayan peaks; Bhairavnath Temple/viewpoint; trek route and river valley.
entry_fee_text: General darshan does not normally require an entry ticket; mandatory pilgrimage registration is free. Optional helicopter, pony, porter and other services cost extra. Confirm current official rules.
opening_hours_text: Seasonal temple opening/closing and daily ritual times are announced by the authorities; check the official Yatra portal immediately before planning.

description: A major Hindu pilgrimage shrine in the Trikuta Hills. Pilgrims generally travel from Katra along the approved route; the Shrine Board offers registration, accommodation and selected transport facilities.
best_time_to_visit: The shrine is visited year-round. October to March is often cooler, while weather, crowd levels and Navratri periods affect the experience.
how_to_reach: Katra is the usual rail/road gateway; Jammu airport and Jammu Tawi are alternatives with onward road travel. Obtain the required Yatra registration/RFID access card before starting the pilgrimage and use official board services.
major_attractions: Main Bhawan; Ardhkuwari; Banganga; Sanjichhat; Bhairon Temple; Trikuta Hills.
entry_fee_text: Yatra registration is free; helicopter, battery-car, accommodation and other optional services have separate charges. Check the official Shrine Board for current rates and rules.
opening_hours_text: Pilgrimage access is regulated by the Shrine Board and can be affected by weather, crowd management and route conditions. Check current notices before departure.

description: A major Vaishnavite Hindu temple dedicated to Sri Venkateswara on the Tirumala Hills, administered by Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD). Darshan systems and ticket categories are administered by TTD.
best_time_to_visit: September to February is generally more comfortable; festivals and weekends can bring very high crowds.
how_to_reach: Reach Tirupati by rail or air, then use TTD or authorized road transport up the hill. Follow current vehicle, queue, darshan and booking instructions from TTD.
major_attractions: Main Venkateswara shrine; Tirumala temple precinct; Sri Vari Pushkarini; Akasa Ganga; Papavinasam; nearby Tirupati temples.
entry_fee_text: Free Sarva Darshan is available subject to queue systems; special-entry darshan and sevas have separate tickets. Check TTD’s current official booking and schedule.
opening_hours_text: Darshan timings vary by day, seva schedule and operational decisions. Consult TTD’s official day schedule close to the visit.

description: A major 12th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra and central to the annual Rath Yatra. The temple complex is a significant part of Odisha’s religious and cultural heritage.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally comfortable. Rath Yatra dates vary annually and cause exceptionally large crowds.
how_to_reach: Puri is the nearest main railway station. Bhubaneswar airport and rail station are major gateways, followed by road or rail transport to Puri.
major_attractions: Main Shree Mandira; Grand Road/Bada Danda; Gundicha Temple; Puri Beach; Raghurajpur craft village.
entry_fee_text: Odisha Tourism lists no entry fee for the temple. Temple-entry rules and permitted visitor groups must be checked with the temple authority before visiting.
opening_hours_text: Odisha Tourism lists approximately 5:00 AM–11:00 PM, varying with rituals; confirm the day’s official schedule and visitor rules.

description: A major Shiva temple on Rameswaram Island, renowned for its long corridors, sacred wells and association with the Ramayana tradition. The temple is administered through Tamil Nadu’s Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department.
best_time_to_visit: October to April is generally more comfortable than peak summer.
how_to_reach: Rameswaram has rail and road connections across the Pamban bridge. Madurai is a major airport/rail gateway with onward train or road travel.
major_attractions: Ramanathaswamy Temple; 22 sacred theerthams; Agni Theertham; Pamban Bridge; Dhanushkodi area.
entry_fee_text: General temple darshan is distinct from paid rituals, special services and bathing arrangements. Check the official HR&CE temple page for current charges.
opening_hours_text: Official temple page lists 4:00 AM–1:00 PM and 3:00 PM–8:00 PM; darshan begins after opening and ritual windows may affect access. Confirm current schedule.

description: A major Hindu Shiva temple in Varanasi, one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, located within the historic city near the Ganges and its ghats.
best_time_to_visit: October to March is generally more comfortable. Major festivals and auspicious dates can be exceptionally crowded.
how_to_reach: Varanasi Junction and Banaras stations serve the city; Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport is the air gateway. Use local transport and follow pedestrian/security instructions around the temple corridor.
major_attractions: Kashi Vishwanath Temple; Ganga ghats; Dashashwamedh Ghat; Manikarnika Ghat; nearby historic lanes and shrines.
entry_fee_text: General darshan is available without a standard entry ticket; special aarti, offerings and premium services may carry fees. Check the official portal for current bookings.
opening_hours_text: The official temple rituals page lists a daily schedule beginning around 2:30 AM and closing around 11:00 PM, with aarti/ritual periods; timings may change.
local_languages: Hindi; Bhojpuri; Sanskrit in rituals; English

description: A UNESCO-listed national park and tiger reserve known for the Indian one-horned rhinoceros, floodplain grasslands, wetlands and varied wildlife. Visitor access is regulated by season, range and safari permit.
best_time_to_visit: November to April; Assam Tourism identifies this as the best general visiting period. Park access is seasonal and can be affected by floods and weather.
how_to_reach: Kohora/Bokakhat is the main gateway. Assam Tourism lists Guwahati and Jorhat as air gateways and road connections from Guwahati; check current railhead and transport options before travel.
major_attractions: Central/Kohora, Western/Bagori, Eastern/Agoratoli and Burapahar ranges where open; jeep/elephant safari options subject to current policy; wildlife interpretation.
entry_fee_text: Park entry and safari/vehicle charges apply and vary by range, safari mode and current rules. Use the official forest department booking/permit portal for current prices.
opening_hours_text: Safari sessions and open ranges are seasonal and permit-based; check current park notices and booking windows.

description: A vast mangrove delta and UNESCO-listed natural heritage area shared by India and Bangladesh, famous for tidal waterways, mangrove ecology, birds, crocodiles and the Royal Bengal tiger. Visits generally require organized boat access and permits.
best_time_to_visit: November to March is commonly recommended by West Bengal Tourism for organized boat tours; weather and forest permissions govern actual access.
how_to_reach: Tour operators commonly organize transfers from Kolkata to designated gateways such as Sonakhali/Godkhali, followed by boat travel. Verify the selected package, boarding point, forest permits and included transport.
major_attractions: Sajnekhali Watch Tower; Sudhanyakhali Watch Tower; Dobanki canopy walk where open; mangrove creeks; local villages and interpretation centres.
entry_fee_text: Do not treat it as a simple walk-in park. Forest permits, guide/boat/package charges and transfers may apply; verify the total included cost with an authorized operator or WBTDCL.
opening_hours_text: Access depends on daylight boat schedules, permitted routes, forest rules, weather and package itinerary. There is no single visitor-hours value for the whole delta.

description: A tiger reserve known for dry-deciduous forest, lakes, rocky hills and the historic Ranthambore Fort. Safaris are permit-controlled and wildlife sightings are never guaranteed.
best_time_to_visit: Rajasthan Tourism states the park is generally open October to June; specific zones and safari dates can vary.
how_to_reach: Sawai Madhopur is the nearest main rail gateway, with onward local transport to safari gates and accommodation. Jaipur and Delhi offer road/rail connections.
major_attractions: Authorized jeep/canter safaris; Ranthambore Fort; Padam Talao; Jogi Mahal area where access permits; wildlife and birdlife.
entry_fee_text: Safari permit, vehicle and guide/driver charges apply and vary by safari type, zone and booking date. Use Rajasthan Forest Department’s official booking portal for live rates.
opening_hours_text: Entry is through booked safari slots, with timings changing seasonally. Consult the official Rajasthan Forest Department permit system.

description: A UNESCO World Heritage wetland and bird sanctuary, important for resident and migratory birds. Visitors can explore on foot or by cycle, cycle-rickshaw, approved battery vehicle or boat when available.
best_time_to_visit: October to February is especially useful for migratory birds; July to September is a breeding season for waterfowl. Park conditions vary seasonally.
how_to_reach: Bharatpur Junction is about 5 km from the park and is connected to major regional cities. Agra and Jaipur are alternative road/air gateways.
major_attractions: Wetland trails; birdwatching; interpretation centre; cycle-rickshaw naturalist tours; nearby Bharatpur Museum and Lohagarh Fort.
entry_fee_text: Rajasthan Forest Department lists ₹75 per Indian visitor per visit on its current page; transport, guide and other service fees are additional. Verify latest rates before travel.
opening_hours_text: The park remains open from sunrise to sunset according to the Rajasthan Forest Department; confirm seasonal notices and activity availability.

description: A high-altitude national park in the Western Ghats, known for Nilgiri tahr, montane grasslands and shola forests; Anamudi, the highest peak in South India, lies within the park region.
best_time_to_visit: Generally November to February is pleasant, but the park has seasonal closures, including monsoon and sensitive wildlife periods; check current notices before planning.
how_to_reach: Munnar is the usual base and is connected by road from Kochi and nearby rail gateways. The park entrance is outside central Munnar; use the official visitor shuttle/transport rules.
major_attractions: Rajamalai visitor zone; Nilgiri tahr habitat; high-altitude grassland and shola scenery; Anamudi area where access is permitted.
entry_fee_text: Kerala Forest Department publication lists an Indian visitor entry charge of ₹60; additional programs or trails may cost extra. Verify the latest official rate and available activities.
opening_hours_text: Kerala Tourism lists 7:00 AM–6:00 PM and notes annual seasonal closure. Actual visitor entry may stop earlier and dates vary; check park notices.

description: A high-altitude Himalayan national park with alpine meadows, seasonal wildflowers, waterfalls and mountain streams. It is part of the UNESCO-listed Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks property.
best_time_to_visit: Official Uttarakhand Tourism says May–October, with peak flower abundance generally July–September. Actual access is seasonal and depends on official opening dates, weather and trail conditions.
how_to_reach: Travel by road to Govindghat, continue to the Ghangaria area, then trek to the valley. Plan for multiple days and check official permits, trail status and weather alerts.
major_attractions: Alpine flower meadows; waterfalls and streams; Himalayan mountain views; nearby Hemkund Sahib pilgrimage route (a separate destination and trek).
entry_fee_text: Entry/permit charges may apply. Current official fees and rules were not confirmed in this pass; check Uttarakhand Forest/Tourism notices before travel.
opening_hours_text: Seasonal daytime trekking access only; official opening dates, permit timings and weather restrictions must be confirmed for the travel year.

description: A well-known sandy beach on Swaraj Dweep, backed by tropical forest and known for sunsets, swimming conditions when safe and coastal scenery.
best_time_to_visit: October to May is commonly recommended by Andaman Tourism; sea and weather conditions vary, especially during monsoon.
how_to_reach: Fly to Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), take an authorized ferry to Swaraj Dweep, then travel roughly 12 km by road from the jetty to Radhanagar Beach. Check ferry schedules and book early.
major_attractions: Radhanagar Beach shoreline and sunset viewpoints; Neil’s Cove only where safely accessible; other Swaraj Dweep beaches and marine activities.
entry_fee_text: The official tourism page does not identify a general beach admission ticket. Ferry, transfers, lockers, water activities and other services cost extra; follow local safety rules.
opening_hours_text: Use only during permitted daylight/safe beach hours; follow on-site warnings, lifeguard directions and current local restrictions. A fixed official hour schedule was not confirmed.
local_languages: Hindi; Bengali; Tamil; Telugu; Nicobarese languages; English

description: A major urban lake at the foot of the Zabarwan hills, associated with houseboats, shikara rides, floating markets and views of Srinagar’s gardens and surrounding mountains.
best_time_to_visit: April to October for milder weather and lake activities; winter offers a different experience but weather and services can be affected by cold.
how_to_reach: Srinagar airport and Srinagar railway/road connections (rail access may require onward road transport from the valley railheads) serve the city. Lake access points are reached by local taxi, bus or auto.
major_attractions: Shikara rides; houseboats; floating gardens/market areas; Mughal gardens; Shankaracharya Hill; nearby Nishat and Shalimar gardens.
entry_fee_text: There is no general lake-entry ticket identified by the tourism source. Shikara rides, houseboats, gardens and other activities have separate charges; agree on prices and duration beforehand.
opening_hours_text: The lake is an open natural area rather than a single ticketed attraction; boat services and individual gardens have their own operating schedules.

description: A high waterfall near Sohra plunging from a green plateau into a pool below, surrounded by cliffs and forested landscapes. Viewpoints provide the main visitor experience.
best_time_to_visit: Meghalaya Tourism recommends October to December for views after the monsoon; heavy rain and mist can affect visibility and road safety.
how_to_reach: Sohra is about 7.5 km from the falls. Travel by road from Shillong or Guwahati, then use a local taxi or arranged transport to the viewpoint.
major_attractions: Nohkalikai viewpoint; surrounding cliffs and forest; nearby Mawsmai Cave and Arwah Cave in the Sohra area.
entry_fee_text: A local viewpoint/parking fee may apply; the fee was not confirmed on the official tourism page. Verify locally and retain a receipt.
opening_hours_text: Meghalaya Tourism lists 8:00 AM–5:00 PM daily; visibility and safe access depend on weather.

description: A popular North Goa beach known for its long sandy shore, tourism facilities, restaurants, beach shacks in permitted seasons and water-sport operators.
best_time_to_visit: November to February is the common dry-season window. Monsoon conditions affect swimming and water-sport availability.
how_to_reach: About 15 km by road from Panaji according to Goa Tourism. Dabolim and Manohar International airports serve Goa; buses, taxis and app-based transport connect the coastal belt.
major_attractions: Calangute shoreline; nearby Baga and Candolim beaches; local markets; permitted seasonal beach activities and water sports.
entry_fee_text: No general beach admission fee is identified by Goa Tourism. Water sports, chairs, food, parking and other commercial services are separately priced; follow official safety advisories.
opening_hours_text: The beach is a public coastal area without a single ticketed gate schedule. Swimming and water sports are subject to lifeguard advice, sea conditions and local rules.
